tasks.title: Fix Assigned To Field Implementation
tasks.description: Update the createTask function to properly handle the assignedTo parameter. Currently accepts the parameter but does not use it (sets people array to empty). Either implement proper people assignment or remove unused parameter.
acceptance_criteria: assignedTo parameter is either properly utilized or removed

tasks.title: Separate Example Usage from Module
tasks.description: Extract the main() function and example usage code into a separate example file. The current implementation executes immediately when the module is imported, which is problematic for production use.
acceptance_criteria: Module can be imported without auto-execution

tasks.title: Add Input Validation
tasks.description: Implement validation for function parameters in createTask and updateTask. Validate required fields, data types, and value constraints before making API calls.
acceptance_criteria: Title parameter validated as non-empty string
Status parameter validated against allowed values
PageId parameter validated as valid UUID format
Appropriate error messages for invalid inputs

tasks.title: Define Status Value Constants
tasks.description: Create a constants file defining all valid status values for tasks. Document the complete status workflow (e.g., To-do, In Progress, Done, Blocked).
acceptance_criteria: All valid status values exported as constants
Functions use constants instead of hardcoded strings

tasks.title: Implement Task Retrieval Function
tasks.description: Create a function to retrieve existing tasks from the Notion database. Support retrieval by task ID and querying tasks by status or other properties.
acceptance_criteria: Proper error handling for not found scenarios

tasks.title: Implement Task Deletion Function
tasks.description: Create a function to archive or delete tasks from the Notion database. Notion API archives pages rather than deleting them.

tasks.title: Implement Bulk Task Operations
tasks.description: Create functions to perform operations on multiple tasks at once. Support bulk creation, bulk status updates, and bulk archival.
acceptance_criteria: Partial success handling (some succeed, some fail)
Return summary of successful and failed operations

tasks.title: Enhance Error Handling
tasks.description: Improve error handling throughout the application. Add retry logic for transient failures, structured error types, and detailed error reporting.
acceptance_criteria: Custom error classes for different failure types
Retry logic for rate limiting and network errors
Error logging with appropriate severity levels

tasks.title: Create Configuration Module
tasks.description: Extract configuration logic into a dedicated module. Validate required environment variables on startup and provide helpful error messages for missing configuration.
acceptance_criteria: config.js validates all required environment variables
Clear error messages for missing configuration
Exported configuration object used by all modules

tasks.title: Create CLI Interface
tasks.description: Build a command-line interface for the task manager. Support commands for create, update, query, and delete operations with argument parsing.

tasks.title: Implement Task Search and Filtering
tasks.description: Add advanced search capabilities to query tasks by multiple criteria. Support text search, date ranges, status filtering, and sorting.
acceptance_criteria: Filtering by status, date range, assignee
Pagination support for large result sets

tasks.title: Add Unit Tests
tasks.description: Create comprehensive unit tests for all functions. Mock Notion API calls and test success paths, error conditions, and edge cases.

tasks.title: Add Integration Tests
tasks.description: Create integration tests that interact with actual Notion test database. Verify end-to-end workflows and API compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: Tests run against dedicated test database
Setup and teardown of test data

tasks.title: Create Comprehensive Documentation
tasks.description: Enhance README with complete setup instructions, API documentation, usage examples, and troubleshooting guide.

tasks.title: Setup CI/CD Pipeline
tasks.description: Configure continuous integration to run tests and linting on pull requests. Setup automated deployment or publishing workflow.
acceptance_criteria: CI runs on all pull requests
Automated testing for multiple Node versions
